lines.text: King Herod had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword, and then seized Peter.
Herod put Peter in prison under guard of four squads of four soldiers each, and Peter slept between two soldiers.
An angel woke Peter, his chains fell off, and the iron gate to the city opened for them by itself.
Peter went to the house of Lydia, and Rhoda ran inside to announce he was at the gate.
Herod went down to Joppa, and after the people called him a god, an angel struck him down.
